## PANW CEO Dismisses AI Existential Threat to Cybersecurity; Niles Sees Software M&A as Sector Floor

The PANW CEO rebuttal directly counters the bear case that AI commoditizes security software, reinforcing the durable-platform thesis; Niles' M&A floor argument is a potential positive re-rating catalyst for software broadly if deal activity continues.

- Palo Alto Networks CEO publicly rejects the thesis that AI poses an existential threat to the cybersecurity sector.
- Investor Dan Niles argues the Workday deal could establish a valuation floor for software stocks broadly.
